title: Seagrove Beach "Kicking Back" 95 Chivas Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gulf-front- Private boardwalk to the beach- 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- Elevator- Outdoor fireplace- Peloton bike- Ping pong table- 4 Adult Bikes- Complimentary beach set up each morning includes 2 beach chairs and 1 umbrella (Service provided Mar 1-Oct 31)- Private pool *Pool heating is available from October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee of $30 per day.- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Experience an unmatched Gulf-front getaway at Kicking Back. Nestled behind the rolling dunes of Seagrove Beach, this exquisite home spans over 3,556 square feet and accommodates 12 guests in absolute comfort, featuring 4 lavishly appointed bedrooms, 4 bathrooms, and 2 half baths. Indulge in unhurried days sunning by the sparkling private pool, enjoying beachfront barbecues, and strolling down the private boardwalk—right off the back deck!Unwind in peaceful bliss on the ground floor of this 3-story beach house. Slatted plank walls allow a constant flow of fresh Gulf air, while 2 swinging daybeds and a ping-pong table invite relaxing with friends and family. An in-home elevator provides effortless access to the rest of the home.Beautifully designed, the main level is a masterpiece of rustic coastal elegance, blending natural textures, hardwood floors, and sweeping vistas through the floor-to-ceiling windows. Sit back and admire the Gulf view from the living area’s plush armchairs and a white slip-covered sofa, or enjoy streaming movies on the Smart TV. The meticulously crafted kitchen—with premium appliances, sleek white cabinetry, and a gorgeous honeycomb tile backsplash—blends style and functionality, making it easy to craft savory meals to share at the traditional dining table for 8 with additional seating for 4 at the kitchen island. When the fresh air calls, step outside to the Gulf-front pool deck, complete with an alfresco 8-seat dining area, outdoor kitchen, panoramic Gulf views, and a beach boardwalk. A sophisticated guest bedroom featuring a queen bed and private bathroom offers a tranquil haven on this level.The top-floor bunk area and additional living space provide 2 twin-over-twin bunks, a cozy couch, a 65” TV, beverage cooler, and more—great for hanging out! The primary bedroom boasts a king bed, private bathroom, and spacious balcony, while the other 2 guest bedrooms each feature a private bathroom and a king bed and queen bed, respectively. There’s a stacked washer and dryer for convenience.A Gulf-front location and incredible amenities, including a Peloton and direct beach access, make Kicking Back the ultimate Seagrove Beach escape. With on-site parking for 4-6 vehicles—plus a 6-passenger low speed vehicle and 4 complimentary adult bikes—it’s easy to explore the area. Book this breathtaking home today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 12):SECOND FLOOR: - Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyTHIRD FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate, Private balcony- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Bunk Area: Two Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds
